metadata.title: SOC 2 common criteria (CC1 to CC9) to Grundschutz++
metadata.remarks:
Generated by grundschutz-worksheets mapping.mjs from a mapping file. Do not edit by hand.

Targets of the BSI mapping not in the catalog, left out (16): BER.5.1.2 (iso27001 8.2); BER.6.8 (iso27001 8.5); GC.6.1.2 (iso27001 5.4); GC.6.1.3 (iso27001 5.1); GC.6.1.3 (iso27001 5.4); GC.6.1.4 (iso27001 5.1); GC.8.1.1 (iso27001 5.2); GC.8.1.1.1 (iso27001 5.4); GC.8.1.3 (iso27001 5.3); GC.8.1.4 (iso27001 5.2); GC.9.1.3 (iso27001 5.37); GC.10.2 (iso27001 5.37); PERF.1.1.1 (iso27001 5.7); PERF.5.1.4 (iso27001 5.35); PERF.6.1.3 (iso27001 5.7); PERF.7.1 (iso27001 5.1).

provenance.mapping-description: The 33 common criteria (CC1.1 to CC9.2) of the AICPA Trust Services Criteria 2017 with the revised points of focus of 2022, the part every SOC 2 report covers. Availability, confidentiality, processing integrity and privacy (A1, C1, PI1, P1 to P8) are in the catalog but not mapped yet. Each criterion names the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls it corresponds to; the Grundschutz++ targets of those controls come from the BSI's own mapping. Direct targets cover what Annex A lacks, notably governance and risk assessment (ISMS clauses 4 to 10). The step from each criterion to ISO and the direct targets are a draft written with AI assistance and not yet reviewed by a person; the AICPA's own mapping to ISO 27001 (2018) is for members only, predates ISO 27001:2022 and was not used. The criteria are the AICPA's: only their IDs are used here, every remark is our own wording.
